info.title: ForgeTrust.AppSurface.Cli
info.description: Command-line tooling for AppSurface repository and documentation workflows.

commands.name: coverage
commands.description: Inspect AppSurface coverage commands for local coverage execution and threshold enforcement.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: gate
commands.description: Enforce line and branch thresholds from a Cobertura coverage file.

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Cobertura XML path. Defaults to TestResults/coverage-merged/coverage.cobertura.xml. Default: <TestResults/coverage-merged/coverage.cobertura.xml>.

options.name: --min-line
options.description: Minimum line coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Default: <0>.

options.name: --min-branch
options.description: Minimum branch coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Default: <0>.

options.name: --diff-base
options.description: Git ref or commit used with HEAD to estimate changed-line coverage.

options.name: --min-patch-line
options.description: Minimum changed-line coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Requires --diff-base.

options.name: --min-patch-branch
options.description: Minimum changed-branch coverage percentage from 0 to 100. Requires --diff-base.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for coverage-gate.json and coverage-gate.md.

options.name: --github-summary
options.description: Append the Markdown report to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when it is set. Default: <true>.

options.name: --no-github-summary
options.description: Do not append to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY even when it is set. Default: <false>.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: merge
commands.description: Merge existing Cobertura shards into local AppSurface coverage artifacts.

options.name: --source
options.description: directory containing coverage.cobertura.xml shard files to merge.

options.name: --output
options.description: Coverage output directory. Defaults to TestResults/coverage-merged. Default: <TestResults/coverage-merged>.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run instrumented .NET tests and merge Cobertura coverage locally.

options.name: --solution
options.description: Solution file used for test project discovery. Supports .sln and .slnx.

options.name: --test-project
options.description: Repeatable explicit test project path. Skips solution discovery when supplied.

options.name: --output
options.description: Coverage output directory. Defaults to TestResults/coverage-merged. Default: <TestResults/coverage-merged>.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: Build/test configuration. Defaults to Debug. Default: <Debug>.

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: Positive integer for non-exclusive test project concurrency. Defaults to 1. Default: <1>.

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Pass --no-restore to build and test commands. Default: <false>.

options.name: --build
options.description: Build the solution once before tests, including explicit-project runs. Default: <false>.

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Skip the solution build before tests. Default: <false>.

options.name: --include
options.description: Coverlet include filter. Omit for Coverlet's project defaults.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Coverlet exclude filter. Defaults to [*.Tests]*,[*.IntegrationTests]*.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print discovery, scheduling, and artifact paths without running tests. Default: <false>.

options.name: --list-projects
options.description: List selected and skipped projects without running tests. Default: <false>.

options.name: --no-discover-exclusive
options.description: Do not auto-classify integration or Playwright projects as exclusive. Default: <false>.

options.name: --exclusive-test-project
options.description: Repeatable project path or file name that should run exclusively.

options.name: --logger
options.description: Repeatable dotnet test logger value, such as junit;LogFilePath=... .

options.name: --test-argument
options.description: Repeatable extra argument token appended to every dotnet test invocation.

options.name: --no-clean
options.description: Do not clean existing AppSurface-owned output before the run. Default: <false>.

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: dotnet test verbosity. Defaults to minimal. Default: <minimal>.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: docs
commands.description: Preview AppSurface Docs for a repository. Related: docs preview, docs export.

options.name: --urls
options.description: URL binding forwarded to the AppSurface Docs host, for example http://127.0.0.1:5189.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port shortcut forwarded to the AppSurface Docs host.

options.name: --all-hosts
options.description: Bind --port previews to localhost and all hosts instead of localhost only. Default: <false>.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Fail startup when every configured AppSurface Docs harvester fails. Default: <false>.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository root to harvest (default: current directory). Default: <.>.

options.name: --route-root
options.description: Route-family root for AppSurface Docs version and archive routes.

options.name: --docs-root
options.description: Live docs root path.

options.name: --public-origin
options.description: Public origin used for absolute AppSurface Docs canonical metadata.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Host environment forwarded to the AppSurface Docs host.

options.name: --startup-timeout-seconds
options.description: Seconds to wait for the AppSurface Docs web host to start before failing fast. Use 0 to disable. Default: <10>.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export AppSurface Docs for a repository to static files.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for exported static docs (default: dist/docs). Default: <dist/docs>.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Export mode: cdn (default) or hybrid. Choices: "Cdn", "Hybrid". Default: <Cdn>.

options.name: --live-origin
options.description: Live origin for RazorWire-managed hybrid interactions, such as https://api.example.com.

options.name: --hybrid-credentials
options.description: Hybrid credentials mode: auto (default), include, or omit. Choices: "Auto", "Include", "Omit". Default: <Auto>.

options.name: --redirects
options.description: Redirect strategy: html (default) or netlify. Choices: "Html", "Netlify". Default: <Html>.

options.name: --seeds
options.description: Path to a file containing seed routes. Defaults to / and the configured docs root.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Fail startup when every configured AppSurface Docs harvester fails. Default: <false>.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Repository root to harvest (default: current directory). Default: <.>.

options.name: --route-root
options.description: Route-family root for AppSurface Docs version and archive routes.

options.name: --docs-root
options.description: Live docs root path.

options.name: --public-origin
options.description: Public origin used for absolute AppSurface Docs canonical metadata.

options.name: --environment
options.description: Host environment forwarded to the AppSurface Docs host.

options.name: --startup-timeout-seconds
options.description: Seconds to wait for the AppSurface Docs web host to start before failing fast. Use 0 to disable. Default: <10>.

options.name: --help
options.description: Shows help text. Default: <false>.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export an AppSurface/RazorWire application to static or hybrid files.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for exported files (default: dist). Default: <dist>.

options.name: --seeds
options.description: Path to a file containing seed routes.

options.name: --publish-root-extras
options.description: Path to a YAML manifest for explicit deployment-owned publish-root files; not route seeds.

options.name: --mode
options.description: Export mode: cdn (default) or hybrid. Choices: "Cdn", "Hybrid". Default: <Cdn>.

options.name: --url
options.description: Base URL of a running application to crawl.

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to a .csproj to run and export.

options.name: --dll
options.description: Path to a .dll to run and export.

options.name: --framework
options.description: Target framework (required for multi-target projects).

options.name: --app-args
options.description: Repeatable app argument token to pass through to the launched target app.

options.name: --no-build
options.description: Project mode only: skip build before launch. Default: <false>.

options.name: --public-origin
options.description: Public static origin for same-origin canonical metadata, such as https://www.example.com.

options.name: --live-origin
options.description: Live origin for RazorWire-managed hybrid interactions, such as https://api.example.com.

options.name: --hybrid-credentials
